products.title: Pink Pom Pom Gota Hanging
products.description: Hand-tied pink pom poms with gota fan accents and a finishing bell. Made for haldi and mehndi settings, and consistent enough to repeat across a large run.

products.title: Green Pom Pom Gota Hanging
products.description: Deep green pom poms with gota medallions and twin bells. The palette can be re-dyed to match your theme.

products.title: Pearl Bead Garland
products.description: Clean white pearl strands with a tight, even bead spacing. Sized for mandap frames, stage backdrops and layered installs.

products.title: Mogra Pearl Bead Hanging
products.description: Dense mogra-bud beading with a soft white sheen. Heavier than the plain pearl strand, so it hangs straighter.

products.title: Pink Blossom Bell Hanging
products.description: Pink blossoms set around a large golden temple bell. Weighted at the base, so it reads well as a single entrance piece.

products.title: Rose Leaf Bell Hanging
products.description: Soft rose blooms with green leafwork and a bell drop. Added this season; lighter in tone than the pink blossom bell.

products.title: Marigold Floral Jhalar
products.description: Full-petal orange marigold (genda) jhalar. Cut and tied for Diwali and Durga Puja installations, and stocked deepest through the festive season.

products.title: Red & White Floral Jhalar
products.description: Red-and-white floral jhalar with green leaf detail — the traditional Bengali colourway for pujas and cultural programmes.

products.title: Mogra Pearl Door Toran
products.description: White mogra-pearl toran with yellow corner accents and a bell centrepiece. Cut to standard doorway width; gate and stage widths made to order.

products.title: Pearl Bandhanwar Toran
products.description: Pearl bandhanwar with red and yellow accents and a hanging bell. The shorter drop suits home and temple doorways.

products.title: Tri-Colour Tassel Latkan
products.description: Layered tri-colour latkan strings with red pom pom drops. The loose ends move in air, so it suits aisles and pillar wraps.

products.title: Red Floral Tassel Hanging
products.description: Rich red floral strands with tassel drops. Flat-backed, so it sits close against walls, columns and window frames.

products.title: Golden Bead String Set
products.description: Fine golden bead strings supplied as a set of three lengths — full, half and spiral — for chandeliers, trees and tabletops.

products.title: Temple Bell Decor String
products.description: Pearl string with pink and green accents and small golden temple charms. Light enough to hang from a thread or a frame.

products.title: Custom Emerald Gota Hanging
products.description: Green-and-orange build with gold diamond motifs and a statement bell. Shown as an example of a custom colourway, not a stock design.

products.title: Custom Sapphire Floral Jhalar
products.description: Blue-and-yellow custom floral jhalar. Another custom example — the same shape can be made in any palette.
